intro: The Pomegranate Glazed Salmon Bowl is a premium offering from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls), featuring perfectly glazed salmon paired with Mediterranean ingredients. This signature bowl combines rich flavors with quality nutrition, making it a standout choice on the [full CAVA menu](/). With saffron basmati rice, creamy hummus, and tangy feta, this dish delivers restaurant-quality taste in a convenient bowl format.
priceCalories: Priced between $16.95 and $18.45, the Pomegranate Glazed Salmon Bowl contains 1040 calories. This makes it one of the heartier options compared to lighter choices like the Greek Salad Bowl at 580 calories. The price reflects the premium quality salmon protein and carefully curated ingredient selection that defines CAVA Curated Bowls.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets this bowl apart is the pomegranate-glazed salmon, which brings a sweet and savory flavor profile unique to Mediterranean cuisine. The combination of saffron basmati rice with crazy feta and lemon herb tahini creates layers of flavor. Unlike standard salmon bowls, the pomegranate glaze adds depth and sophistication. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to explore customization options.
nutritionFacts: Each bowl provides 36g of protein, 80g of carbohydrates, and 65g of fat, totaling 1040 calories. The salmon delivers high-quality omega-3 fatty acids and complete protein. The carbohydrates come primarily from saffron basmati rice, while healthy fats are provided by tahini, hummus, and salmon. This macronutrient balance supports sustained energy and satiety throughout your day.
whatsInside: This curated bowl features pomegranate glazed salmon as the star protein, served over aromatic saffron basmati rice. Creamy hummus and crazy feta add richness, while fresh tomato and cucumber provide crisp texture. Crunchy pita crisps offer textural contrast, and lemon herb tahini ties everything together with bright, herbaceous notes. Each component is thoughtfully selected from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) and [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings).
tasteLike: The bowl offers a harmonious blend of sweet, savory, and tangy flavors. The pomegranate glaze provides a subtle sweetness that complements the rich, flaky salmon. Crazy feta adds a creamy, tangy punch while the lemon herb tahini brings brightness and herbal notes. The saffron rice contributes earthy warmth, and fresh vegetables add crisp freshness to each bite.
customize: Customize your bowl by adjusting portions or swapping ingredients through the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator). Replace saffron rice with other options from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) like greens or grains. Add extra toppings, switch dressings from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings), or include additional dips from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) for personalized flavor.
pairsWell: This salmon bowl pairs excellently with light sides and refreshing beverages. Consider adding a side from the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) like roasted vegetables or a small salad. The rich flavors complement sparkling water or iced tea from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks). For dessert, try something light to balance the hearty bowl. The bold flavors also work well before or after items from the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas).
healthyChoice: With 36g of protein and omega-3 rich salmon, this bowl supports muscle maintenance and heart health. The combination of whole grains, vegetables, and healthy fats provides balanced nutrition. While higher in calories at 1040, it offers substantial nutrition for active individuals. The fresh vegetables and quality ingredients align with Mediterranean diet principles known for promoting overall wellness and longevity.
howToOrder: Order the Pomegranate Glazed Salmon Bowl at any [CAVA Locations](/locations) by requesting it from the Curated Bowls section. You can order in-store, through the CAVA app, or via delivery platforms. Specify any customizations when ordering. The bowl comes fully assembled with all listed ingredients, but you can request modifications. Review the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) if you have dietary restrictions.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the Chicken + Rice Bowl at 700 calories and $12.85-$13.45, the salmon option offers more omega-3s and premium protein at a higher price point. The Harissa Avocado Bowl provides 830 calories for $13.95-$14.95 with plant-forward ingredients. The Falafel Crunch Bowl delivers 860 calories at $13.45-$14.45 for a vegetarian alternative. The salmon bowl stands out for seafood lovers seeking premium Mediterranean flavors.
whoShouldTry: This bowl is perfect for seafood enthusiasts who appreciate Mediterranean flavors and quality ingredients. Active individuals needing substantial calories and protein will find it satisfying. Those following pescatarian diets or seeking omega-3 rich meals should consider this option. If you enjoy sweet and savory combinations or want to try something beyond standard chicken bowls, the pomegranate glazed salmon delivers exceptional taste.
worthTrying: The Pomegranate Glazed Salmon Bowl is absolutely worth trying for its unique flavor profile and quality ingredients. While priced higher than other curated bowls, the premium salmon and thoughtful ingredient pairing justify the cost. The pomegranate glaze distinguishes it from typical salmon dishes. For those seeking a restaurant-quality Mediterranean meal with balanced nutrition and bold flavors, this bowl delivers excellent value.

faqs.q: How many calories are in the Pomegranate Glazed Salmon Bowl?
faqs.a: The Pomegranate Glazed Salmon Bowl contains 1040 calories, with 36g of protein, 80g of carbohydrates, and 65g of fat. This makes it one of the more substantial options on the CAVA menu, suitable for those seeking a filling, protein-rich meal.

faqs.q: What is the price of the Pomegranate Glazed Salmon Bowl?
faqs.a: The Pomegranate Glazed Salmon Bowl is priced between $16.95 and $18.45, depending on your location. This premium pricing reflects the quality salmon and curated ingredient selection that sets this bowl apart from standard menu options.

faqs.q: Can I customize the Pomegranate Glazed Salmon Bowl?
faqs.a: Yes, you can customize the bowl by adjusting ingredients, changing the base, adding extra toppings, or selecting different dressings. Use the CAVA Nutrition Calculator to explore modifications and see how changes affect nutritional content while maintaining your preferred flavor profile.

faqs.q: Is the Pomegranate Glazed Salmon Bowl gluten-free?
faqs.a: The bowl contains pita crisps which include gluten. However, you can make it gluten-free by requesting no pita crisps and verifying other ingredients. Check the CAVA Gluten Free Menu and CAVA Allergen Menu for detailed information about allergens and safe substitutions.

faqs.q: What makes the Pomegranate Glazed Salmon Bowl special?
faqs.a: The pomegranate glaze on the salmon creates a unique sweet and savory flavor profile that distinguishes this bowl from standard salmon dishes. Combined with saffron basmati rice, crazy feta, and lemon herb tahini, it offers restaurant-quality Mediterranean taste with balanced nutrition and premium ingredients.
